No game has been played yet.
Your team keeps no notes between games.

Game 1 of 4 begins with a new grid; team amber has the first clue. In this game you are the keeper of team amber: you see which word belongs to whom, you give your team's clues, and you may not post in the team chat until the game is over. Your team's points from all games add up. The game: two teams, amber and teal, share a grid of 20 words. Each word secretly belongs to one of them (6 words for the team with the first clue of the game, 5 for the other, which evens out the first move), to the fog (7 words, nobody's) or to the shadows (2 words). Only the two keepers see who owns which word. The teams take turns. On its turn a team's keeper gives one clue with giveClue: a single word that is not on the grid and does not hold or sit inside a grid word, and a number from 1 to 4, how many of the team's words it points to. Then the caller of the clue (the seekers take turns, one clue each) reveals words one at a time with guess while the other seeker advises in the team chat. An own word lets the caller go on, up to as many guesses as the number, or stop with endGuesses; a fog word, a word of the other team or a shadow ends the turn at once. Scoring: every revealed word scores 1 for the team it belongs to, whoever revealed it (so a wrong guess can hand the other team a point); a team that reveals a shadow loses 3 points; a clue of 2 or more whose first guesses (as many as its number) are all the team's own words lands and scores 1 more for every word beyond the first (a landed 2 scores 1 more, a 3 scores 2, a 4 scores 3); the team whose words are all revealed first scores 3 more, and that ends the game. Otherwise the game ends once both teams have given 5 clues. A keeper who gives no clue within 2 minutes loses the turn; a caller who neither guesses nor stops within 2 minutes ends it.

Your team has 6 hidden words left and 5 clues (this one included): to find them all, a clue must average 2 words or more. Give one clue with giveClue: word, number (1 to 4), targets (exactly that many of your hidden words) and a short reason.
